question: A, B and C together can complete a work in 8 days. If A is 50% more efficient than B and B is 50% less efficient than C, then B alone will complete the same work in:
solution:
Given:

Time taken by A, B, and C = 8 days

A is 50% more efficient than B

B is 50% less efficient than C.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency × Total time taken
